records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, North Studio!
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: A quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Sorry we missed each other last week -- happy to find a new time whenever suits you.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the fastest way to see how it fits North Studio's work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
